title: Startup application of persisted settings and pause-on-open effect have zero coverage
evidence:
app/main.odin:276-279:
	app.a11y = settings_load()
	rnd.palette_apply_mode(&app.palette_base, &app.palette, app.a11y.palette)
	app.view.reduced_motion = app.a11y.reduced_motion
	app.view.ui_scale = scale_of(app.a11y.scale_step)
detail: All pieces are unit-tested but the composition is not: dropping these four lines (persistence silently dead on relaunch) or the Run→Paused transition in effect_settings fails no test.
recommended_fix: Add a package-main probe: save non-default settings, run the load→apply composition, assert view.ui_scale/reduced_motion/palette.mode; assert effect_settings pauses a Run-mode app.

title: settings_test_seq is an unsynchronized package global — concurrent @(test) execution can collide on one temp path
detail: The increment is not atomic; two concurrently running tests can read the same counter value, build the same path, and corrupt each other's fixtures (e.g. truncated-file bytes under a round-trip) — a flaky CI gate.
recommended_fix: Derive the path from the test name or an atomically incremented counter (core:sync) plus the pid, so concurrent tests never share a fixture path.

title: hud_zero_scale_defaults_after_view_compute never calls view_compute — the production zero-scale guard it claims to pin is untested
detail: The test re-implements the guard inline instead of invoking view_compute; deleting the guard in view.odin fails nothing while the r2 PR body claims hud_test 'pins the zero-scale guard'. Vacuous coverage counts as a gap.
recommended_fix: Zero-init a View with a minimal Balance, call rnd.view_compute(&v, 1280, 720, &bal), then assert v.ui_scale == 1.0 and hud(&v, 440) == 440.

title: Panel-navigation wrap and ±1 value-step mappings are unexercised by any scenario
detail: Both wrap branches and the Settings_Activate{±1} mappings (mouse Left/Right, pad Dpad_Left/Right) have no coverage; a broken wrap or dead step key passes all 27 scenarios.
recommended_fix: Extend input_parity_settings_panel: press Up from row 0 (assert wrap to row 3) and a Left then Right step on keyboard and pad legs.
